feature.title: Feature toggle
feature.description: Agent groups are disabled by default on fresh installs. Enable the feature before users can create groups.

runtime.title: Runtime limits
runtime.description: Limits applied to every agent group run.

enabled.label: Enable agent groups
enabled.description: Allow creating agent groups (1 supervisor + up to 31 workers).

maxStepsPerRun.label: Max decision steps per run
maxStepsPerRun.description: Maximum number of decision steps for a single run before it is force-stopped.

maxAttemptsPerStep.label: Max attempts per step
maxAttemptsPerStep.description: How many times a step may be retried before the run fails.

attemptLeaseSeconds.label: Attempt lease (seconds)
attemptLeaseSeconds.description: How long an in-flight attempt may hold its lease before it is considered crashed and reclaimed.

toast.loadFailed: Failed to load agent group settings
toast.saveFailed: Failed to save agent group settings
